message:
I am thinking...: OK, so `ssh_packet_process` dispatches to the callbacks registered in `session->packet_callbacks` list, which includes `default_packet_handlers`. There's no filtering/blocking of specific packet types based on session state in this dispatch function. 

This means if I can get the session past the banner exchange (so that it starts processing binary SSH packets), I can send ANY packet type and it will be dispatched to the handler - including SSH2_MSG_USERAUTH_REQUEST (type 50) even before key exchange is complete!

However, looking at the fuzzer more carefully, I need to understand how `ssh_handle_key_exchange` works. If it processes all incoming data and waits for key exchange to finish, it won't get to the message loop until it returns. But the packet callbacks are called during key exchange processing!

Wait, actually let me re-read the fuzzer code.
